llm.summary: The skill is internally coherent but does not provide live tracking — it simulates demo tracking for a small set of carriers despite claiming '100+ carriers'.

dimensions.detail: The name/description promise (live tracking from 100+ carriers) does not match the implementation. scripts/track.py contains a small hard-coded CARRIERS table and simulate_tracking() that returns demo data with a 'Demo data' note rather than performing live API queries. The claim of 100+ carriers and real-time status is therefore misleading.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a local demo: the Python script generates simulated tracking timelines and explicitly notes 'Demo data' rather than calling carrier APIs. If you expect real-time tracking from many carriers, this skill will not deliver that — you'd need a version that integrates real carrier APIs (which would require network access and credentials). The code itself is small and readable (no network calls or secret access), so it's low-risk to inspect or run locally. Before installing or using it widely: 1) verify the source (homepage is missing and the owner is unknown), 2) confirm you accept demo-only behavior, 3) if a future version claims live tracking, review what new env vars or network calls it requires (carrier API keys and endpoints), and 4) avoid entering sensitive tracking numbers into untrusted or remote skills — future versions that send numbers to third-party APIs could expose that data.
